description: T3 Code is an open-source control surface for running and remotely operating coding-agent tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Antigravity on your own machines. It provides desktop, web, mobile, and CLI access to those environments, plus MCP access for outside agents.
summary: t3.codes exposes a hosted web app at `app.t3.codes`, an environment-scoped MCP server at `https://<environment-address>/mcp`, and the `t3` CLI; documented authentication is via T3 Connect sign-in for remote access and OAuth for MCP clients.
